name: HZ_STYLE_FMT_LAYOUTS_B
description: The HZ_STYLE_FMT_LAYOUTS_B table identifies which attributes appear in a particular style format, as well as the sequence and lines they are displayed in and delimiters that they are  separated by.

columns.name: STYLE_FMT_LAYOUT_ID
columns.description: Sequence generated unique identifier for style format layout row.

columns.name: STYLE_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Identifies style format for variation.

columns.name: VARIATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequential number within style format to identify Variation.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies component or attribute being laid out.

columns.name: COMP_STYLE_CODE
columns.description: Unique code to represent the style.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Indicates line that attribute should be formatted on.

columns.name: POSITION
columns.description: Indicates position on the line that attribute should be placed.

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether attribute is mandatory for layout or not.

columns.name: USE_INITIAL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether only initial character of attribute should be used or not.

columns.name: UPPERCASE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether attribute should be translated to uppercase or not.

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Status of style format layout code. A for active or I for inactive.

columns.name: TRANSFORM_FUNCTION
columns.description: Identifies PL/SQL function with optional parameters that must be called to transform attribute.

columns.name: DELIMITER_BEFORE
columns.description: One or more characters to be placed before attribute if attribute is not null.

columns.name: DELIMITER_AFTER
columns.description: One or more characters to be placed after attribute if attribute is not null.

columns.name: BLANK_LINES_BEFORE
columns.description: Number of blank lines to display before attribute. Only valid for first attribute on new line.

columns.name: BLANK_LINES_AFTER
columns.description: Number of blank lines to display after attribute. Only valid for last attribute on given line.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date of record activation

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date of record deactivation

columns.name: DISPLAY_SIZE
columns.description: Identifies the maximum display size of the attribute for info entry.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
